bug_probe.title: Plot locks with a non-owner inside: the intruder is put outside the gate, on the ground, facing out

note: locked-base trap (advisory): luau/lock_eject teleports the real player into a free plot, locks it and calls the real WorldView.ejectIntruders on a mirror World; asserts outside the front slab (WorldLayout.frontBarrier), on the ground, facing out, and that a second call is a no-op
